stem: Chirag works one integer worksheet that mixes number-line moves, token debts and credits, and rewriting subtraction as adding the inverse.

parts.text: Which claim correctly describes the operations on that worksheet?

options.text: The worksheet uses one coherent signed-number operation system, shown in different models.
Report the words number line as the answer and stop.
The number-line picture produces the integer rules, so start from a drawn arrow and invent a new operation book.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Number-line moves, tokens, and adding the inverse are models of the same signed-number operations, not separate rule books.

teacher.key_rationale: Mixed integer practice consolidates into one signed-number system. Naming the number-line label alone, or reversing so a picture invents a new rule book, miss that coherence.
